key_concepts: Flowers are the reproductive organs of some plants
Complete flowers have both male and female reproductive parts while incomplete flowers hav
The pistil or carpel is the female reproductive organ made of stigma, style, and ovary
The stamen is the male reproductive organ made of filament and anther
The anther produces and releases pollen grains, the male sex cells
The stigma is sticky and traps pollen grains
The stigma secretes a fluid that stimulates pollen grains to germinate
The style connects the stigma to the ovary and serves as the pollen pathway
The ovary contains ovules or eggs and fertilized ovules develop into seeds
Pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther to the stigma by wind, birds, or ins
Fertilization is the union of sperm and egg cell
After fertilization, seeds are scattered by dispersal and some grow into new plants
